about: Hand-written prompts for the Promise Ledger human-review pack (scripts/promise_review_pack.py). These are questions for a reviewer and notes by the preparer, written by Claude (AI assistant) on 2026-10-27. They are not source facts and record no review outcome: every fact in the pack comes from snapshot/promise_ledger.json and config/promise_audit.json.

questions.TCS-ebit-exit-25: This record was changed on the reviewer's instruction (2026-10-27): the Q2 FY27 p.16 "uphill task" answer is read as cautionary context, so the verdict is **pending**, not **not reaffirmed**. For sign-off: is that reading right? Is (EBITDA − D&A) / revenue an acceptable stand-in for TCS's "operating margin" (it reproduces the stated 24%, but TCS's definition is not in the snapshot)? Does "exit" mean Q4 FY27? Does the risk note describe the headwinds fairly?
questions.TCS-aspiration-26-28: The statement is now the CFO's Q3 FY26 p.23 answer ("we want to inch closer to our 26% to 28% band and we'll make all efforts to climb towards 26%"), restated twice in Q2 FY27. Is "climb towards 26%" the same aspiration as the band, as recorded, rather than a nearer-term target? Is **commentary** (never scored) the right classification? The horizon basis now quotes management's own 'long-term', and the p.27 answer shows the question that prompted it (whether TCS would revise the band).
questions.POLYCAB-wc-ebitda-11-13: The quoted sentence (Q3 FY26 p.15) names neither the segment nor EBITDA. Is it right to take **Wires & Cables** and **EBITDA** from the later statements (Q4 FY26 p.13, Q1 FY27 p.5, Q2 FY27 p.7)? And is it right to refuse to compare the target with the segment's reported **EBIT** (13.3%, 14.2%) or with the consolidated margin? A further restatement (Q1 FY27 p.12) was added at review.
questions.POLYCAB-fmeg-ebitda-8-10: Is the Q1 FY27 p.6 follow-up a restatement, given that it sets an EBIT result beside an EBITDA target? Is it right not to treat that 8% EBIT figure as progress against the target?
questions.POLYCAB-capex-12-16bn: Is the unit (₹ bn per year, through FY30) right? Is it right to show management's own FY26 figure (INR 14.8 bn) without checking it, and to keep the ~90% Cables & Wires split as a follow-up rather than a separate commitment? Management's H1 FY27 figure (INR 6.1 bn) was added as unchecked context; a half-year figure is not an annual outcome.
questions.POLYCAB-working-capital-days: The target field holds the range as first stated, **50 to 55 days** (Q3 FY26 p.5). From Q4 FY26 management gives **45 to 50 days** without mentioning the earlier range, and FINN records that as `tightened`. Is a revised target the right reading, rather than the same target stated on a different basis? Is "in the coming quarters" too vague to date the record, which leaves it **unverifiable**? Are management's reported cycle figures (27, 25, 15 and 11 days, all below both ranges) correctly shown as unchecked context rather than as evidence of a miss?
questions.POLYCAB-ehv-commissioning: Does the Q2 FY27 p.18 statement move the EHV plant from end-CY2026 to FY28, making the stance `delayed` and the verdict **not reaffirmed**? Is it right not to call it missed while the original date (31 Dec 2026) has not passed?
questions.POLYCAB-cw-growth-1.5x: The horizon is now management's "until FY30" (Q1 FY27 p.18), which makes the verdict **pending**, not **unverifiable**. Is that a stated end date for the commitment? Is it right to treat it as a volume-growth target against "market growth", and to keep the "1.5x of GDP growth" answer (Q4 FY26 p.15) as a different benchmark?
questions.POLYCAB-exports-10pct: Is "greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030" correctly read as "more than 10% of revenue by FY30"? Management's figures (5.4% for FY26; about 5% in Q2 FY27, p.16) are shown unchecked. Is it right not to treat the absence of a Q2 FY27 restatement of 10% as a change?
questions.POLYCAB-epc-margin: Is "high single digits over mid- to long term" measurable enough to be `measurable_qualitative` rather than commentary? Is "widened" (to "mid- to high") followed by "restated" the right stance sequence?
questions.POLYCAB-dividend-payout-30: The payout base (dividend over which profit) is not stated. Should the record stand as a commitment that is **pending** until FY2030? Is it right that no later mention exists in Q1 or Q2 FY27?
questions.HDFCBANK-ldr-85-90: Given the hedges ("maybe", "I think", "somewhere around"), is this an explicit numeric commitment? Is the revised verdict **pending** right? The earlier version called the Q4 FY26 "not a constraint" remark softening, which would make it **not reaffirmed**. The CEO's Q3 FY26 p.8 answer is now recorded as two `explained` follow-ups: 'a broad range', with '90%' meaning roughly 88% to 91%, and 'somewhere around the 90%' being acceptable. Is it right to keep 85% to 90% as the target and treat the clarification as management's reading of it, not a revision? How should an outcome of about 91%, above the stated range but inside management's own reading, be judged if loan and deposit data are ever added?
questions.HDFCBANK-ldr-fy26-90-96: Does the sentence meet the same inclusion criteria as the dividend record? Is "we will try and be in a range… which is… what we are very confident about" a commitment rather than an aspiration? FY26 has closed, FINN holds no loan or deposit figures, and no FY26 ratio was found in the later calls: is **unverifiable** the honest verdict, rather than met or missed?
questions.HDFCBANK-growth-vs-system-fy26: Should one sentence produce two records (FY26 and FY27)? For FY26, management's own figures (12% credit growth against a system it puts at 13.5–13.9%) are shown but not scored. Is **unverifiable** the honest verdict, given that "top line growth" is undefined?
questions.HDFCBANK-growth-vs-system-fy27: Are the Q4 FY26 p.6 and Q1 FY27 p.14 answers neutral (`not_restated`), as revised, or do they weaken the commitment (`softened`), as the earlier version said? That decision moves the verdict between **pending** and **not reaffirmed**.
questions.HDFCBANK-msme-growth: Management said "in that range of 18% to 20%, 21%". Is the widest reading (18–21%) the right target? Should the record be **unverifiable** because it is undated and conditional? Is "business banking" the right segment label?
questions.HDFCBANK-margin-change-2q: The sentence's label was changed from `measurable_qualitative` to `commentary` while the ledger was being built. Is "you will see that change" commentary? What it refers to comes only from the analyst's question.

flags.HDFCBANK-growth-vs-system-fy26: This record and HDFCBANK-growth-vs-system-fy27 quote the same sentence (Q3 FY26 p.4).

corrections_before_review.what: `audit_note` cited "p.5" for the sentence the filter missed; the sentence is on Q4 FY26 p.8, and no POLYCAB transcript has an export target on p.5. The note now says p.8. Quote, page, speaker and verdict unchanged.

The target field held 45 to 50 days, the later range, although the record's statement says 50 to 55 days. It now holds 50 to 55 days. The title, interpretation, audit note and the Q4 FY26 follow-up note set out the chronology. Verdict unchanged (unverifiable: undated, and working-capital days are not in the snapshot).

On the reviewer's instruction: the Q2 FY27 p.16 "uphill task" answer changed from `softened` to `not_restated` (cautionary context, not a revision of the 25% target). Verdict **not reaffirmed → pending**. Risk note, margin-formula caveat and the inferred Q4 FY27 horizon kept.

The statement is now the CFO's Q3 FY26 p.23 answer, the earliest in these calls; the former Q2 FY27 p.15 statement is a `restated` follow-up with its analyst question. The audit note no longer calls p.23 analyst-only, and the sentence is logged as a known miss. Verdict unchanged (unverifiable).
Added management's reported cycle as four `reported` follow-ups (27, 25, 15, 11 days), each marked unchecked. Verdict unchanged (unverifiable).

Horizon changed from "each full year, no end date" to "each year through FY30", stated by management (Q1 FY27 p.18, now quoted in full). Verdict **unverifiable → pending**, under the same rule as the capex and export records.
Added the Q1 FY27 p.12 restatement. Verdict unchanged (pending).
Added management's H1 FY27 capex (INR 6.1 bn) as a `reported` follow-up, unchecked. Verdict unchanged (pending).
New record, added on the reviewer's instruction (see "Why 17 records"). Verdict **unverifiable**.

Added the CEO's Q3 FY26 p.8 answer to the analyst's FY27 question as two `explained` follow-ups ('a broad range'; '90%' meaning roughly 88% to 91%; 'somewhere around the 90%'). The 85% to 90% target is unchanged. FY26-only sentences from the same answer stay with HDFCBANK-ldr-fy26-90-96. Verdict unchanged (pending).

omitted_commitments: POLYCAB "we've given a guidance that we want to spend around 3% to 5% of B2C top-line every year on A&P" (Q3 FY26 p.14)
The same answer adds "it will be difficult to say that this will be every year". It allocates an operating cost, and its base is not a reported figure
POLYCAB "around 90% of that will go into Cable & Wire capacity expansion alone" (Q4 FY26 p.16)
It is a split of the capex record, not a separate commitment
TCS "progressively inch up closer, at least to the FY26 levels" (Q1 FY27 p.23)
Aspiration with no number or date. The 25% exit from the same call is «TCS-ebit-exit-25»
POLYCAB ₹60–80 bn five-year capex programme and "₹6,000 to ₹8,000 crores by FY2030"
POLYCAB FMEG "1.5x to 2x of industry growth"
Minor; it is in the same sentence as «POLYCAB-fmeg-ebitda-8-10». Can be promoted by the same criteria
Given in the same answer as the 11–13% restatement

additions.why: added in the final corrections. "…towards our stated objective of exceeding 30% by FY 2030" (Q4 FY26 p.9). The filter had no dividend keyword.

added at review on the reviewer's instruction, 2026-10-27. "We said we will try and be in a range of somewhere between 90% to 96% in the year FY '26, which is what we will be is what we are very confident about" (Q3 FY26 p.6, CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan), repeated on p.8. The p.6 label belongs to the FY27 sentence that follows it.
